authority.ledger_policy: The historical 45-row ledger remains source evidence; authority/LEDGER-OBLIGATIONS.md is a read-only selected obligation record, not a duplicate ledger.

routing.route_note: P0.b, P1, and P2 are explicitly routed to the configured xhard role by the standing source policy; this is not an inference from task size. The configured final reviewer is a separate leaf context and must not review its own implementation.
routing.grok: not on default route; requires explicit user reopening

global_constraints: No GPU/provider fire until P0.d reconciles historical spend and attempts and signs remaining allowance.
Preserve the USD 6 aggregate cap, maximum two live attempts per engine/profile cluster, maximum three hours per pod, 4 GiB free-space floor, and 2 GiB run-generated evidence/scratch cap.
No model downloads; use pinned, reviewed source and dependency identities.
No overlay wholesale restoration; verification bypasses are immediate stop conditions.
No task is accepted merely because it is assigned a terminal status; unsuccessful outcomes must be honest and never marked EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Complete offline custody bundles
tasks.outcome: Bundle the three recovered tips not covered by the existing ffef517a-lineage bundle and verify all four recovered tips are independently restorable offline.
tasks.acceptance: A custody receipt names every tip, bundle/hash, and restoration check; no product source is changed.

tasks.title: Bounded Fire-19 backend recovery or reconstruction
tasks.outcome: Attempt bounded recovery of the exact missing backends/vibecomfy.py; if unavailable, reconstruct from_host_session and run_compiled_workflow against the preserved fire7 call shape and c7f5b33d binding semantics, recovering valid repairs individually.
tasks.route_reason: Standing routing explicitly assigns reconstruction and P1/P2 hard implementation to the configured xhard role; exact recovery is uncertain and consequential.
tasks.acceptance: Receipt states exact recovery found or unavailable, records reconstructed contracts/tests, and proves no no-op source verification, timestamp-only liveness, digest substitution, readiness injection, or settlement rewriting entered the candidate.

tasks.title: Prepare composition identity inputs
tasks.outcome: Prepare complete composition manifest inputs for an M1 preliminary composition; final B06-T01 freezing is a distinct P7 task after CR2.
tasks.acceptance: Inputs are sufficient to record M1 after P1-P3; no current-main observation silently substitutes for a pinned identity. Final B06-T01 pinning is accepted only by P7.freeze after CR2 PASS.

tasks.title: Reconcile inherited provider budget and attempts
tasks.outcome: Reconstruct historical spend and 19 historical fires, determine the unproven attempt balance and remaining USD 6 allowance, set per-fire limits/abort conditions, and reserve final-run budget.
tasks.acceptance: Signed CPU-side budget receipt with provenance, remaining allowance, attempt balance, limits, and cleanup evidence; until then all GPU work is blocked. Unknown counts are reconciled, not reset.

tasks.title: Apply adjudicated ledger correction of record
tasks.outcome: In the future authorized execution, synchronize the canonical tasklist/ledger with 22 accepted scoped closures, reopened B03-T01 HC-04 correction, 22 original pending rows, blocked B03-T05a-e receipts, and corrected blocker state.
tasks.acceptance: Canonical ledger diff matches the v3 adjudication verbatim and preserves historical evidence; no pending row is closed by discovery alone. This planning artifact does not edit that ledger.

tasks.title: Verify local capacity and isolated custody prerequisites
tasks.outcome: Verify at least 4 GiB free, enforce a 2 GiB run evidence/scratch cap, and establish protected dirty-checkout and isolated-worktree rules, including unusable Runtime local custody as a recovery prerequisite.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh preflight receipt records capacity, protected dirty paths, usable isolated custody, and exact interpreter/package identity; capacity failure blocks expensive work.

tasks.title: Enforce routing and honest-outcome policy
tasks.outcome: Install the role boundary: the configured coordinator directs, the normal worker handles normal work, the configured xhard role handles P0.b/P1/P2 hard work, and the configured oracle/final reviewer retain their independent responsibilities; no unconfigured route is used unless explicitly reopened.
tasks.acceptance: Coordinator-readable dispatch rules resolve every future task through run.yaml, preserve counters, prohibit self-review, and forbid EXECUTED for unsuccessful outcomes.

tasks.title: Integrate VibeComfy content in clean custody
tasks.outcome: Merge authored fix/S1 content into the cb130f1b lineage containing c7f5b33d launch-marker ownership, reconcile the expected file set, and produce one branch consumed by both pip_embedded and checkout paths.
tasks.route_reason: Standing source routing assigns the Vibe integration hard lane to the configured xhard role; reviewer remains independent.
tasks.acceptance: Focused CPU tests and an independent review prove real authored content (not ancestry-only probe merge), launch-marker ownership, modern SessionConfig, and both profile consumers.

tasks.title: Accept corrected HC-04 Runtime handoff
tasks.outcome: Validate Runtime 70872d03 with app cf9d772be, complete the corrected schema/CAS/catalog handoff, and obtain the required independent acceptance before producer/deletion work.
tasks.route_reason: The adjudication binding directive makes corrected HC-04 acceptance a consequential xhard-role handoff prerequisite.
tasks.acceptance: Focused schema/CAS/catalog tests and an independent acceptance receipt prove the corrected handoff; the settled canonical SHA-256 object-ID decision is preserved and the prior authority correction remains unaccepted until this task passes.

tasks.title: Build engine-neutral ManagedToolSession core
tasks.outcome: Implement and CPU-test GenericPackHost custody envelopes, capability descriptors, warm-slot/capacity policy, generation/admission fencing, checkout adapter binding, and evidence-integrity construction.
tasks.route_reason: Standing source routing assigns manager core and checkout reconstruction hard implementation to the configured xhard role; reviewer is a separate leaf.
tasks.acceptance: CPU fault-injection proof covers wrapper loss, orphan/PID reuse, restart race, port release, uncertain cancellation, stale admission, and settlement fencing; independent review finds no verification bypass or second durable authority.

tasks.title: Convert harness to session-aware evidence
tasks.outcome: Rewrite lifecycle assertions around manager-issued evidence and independent observation, decouple warm expectation from listener ports, delete start_checkout adoption, and freeze the actual executable case inventory.
tasks.acceptance: Focused CPU fixtures prove session identity, cancellation, restart, stale-fence, CAS/settlement, cleanup, and inventory completeness without claiming GPU acceptance.

tasks.title: Prove checkout lifecycle on first budgeted fire
tasks.outcome: After preflight, prove checkout_server cold, warm/nonreuse, cancel, changed_identity, restart, binding, per-case receipts, output hashes, and task-to-output bindings.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh provider/capacity preflight plus receipted lifecycle evidence proves runtime binding and owned-resource cleanup; no inferred zero pods and no overlay-only proof.

tasks.title: Composition and code-level blocker checkpoint
tasks.outcome: Record the preliminary integrated composition after P1-P3, confirm the code-level C12 blocker is cleared, and confirm signed budget/custody preconditions before the first GPU proof.
tasks.acceptance: M1 receipt pins the preliminary composition and CPU evidence, records code-level blocker closure, and references signed P0.d/P0.f evidence. It is not the final B06-T01 freeze and does not close any GPU or final-ledger row.

tasks.title: Prove Wan persistent runner and residency feasibility
tasks.outcome: Prove the CPU retention seam, correct the task-independent resident key, run the explicit GPU feasibility gate, preserve canonical MP4 metadata, and keep warm_reuse_expected false unless evidence passes.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence includes observed incarnation, no reconstruction event, resident components/VRAM/load-time delta, canonical output equality, cancellation, restart and A→B→A behavior; an infeasible gate is recorded honestly.

tasks.title: Prove embedded retained session
tasks.outcome: Prove retention across the per-task production_runner boundary, with cancellation semantics and the same evidence class used for Wan before any warm-policy flip.
tasks.acceptance: CPU seam proof and, if budgeted, GPU evidence establish retained-session lifecycle and safe nonreuse; unsupported warmth remains explicitly unsupported rather than relabeled.

tasks.title: Complete CPU producer/deletion closure chain and CR2
tasks.outcome: Complete the outstanding source/deletion chain and obtain B05-T04 / CR2 PASS.
tasks.acceptance: Focused CPU source/tests/docs and accepted reviews close the five B03-T05 children and aggregate, B03-T08, B04-T04 through T07, then B05-T01 through T04; deletion proof includes inpaint_frames and qwen_image_hires negative evidence, Supabase-lifecycle removal, and unrelated Stage1 preservation. CR2 receipt is PASS. No final freeze is allowed before this task.

tasks.title: Freeze final immutable composition
tasks.outcome: After CR2, pin one complete execution-affecting composition and freeze the actual harness case inventory.
tasks.acceptance: B06-T01/B06-T02 receipts pin all sources, dependencies, config, profiles, interpreter/node/model manifests, case inventory, fresh provider state, capacity, spend/attempt allowance, and cleanup authority. CR2 PASS is an explicit prerequisite.

tasks.title: Run final CPU and real-GPU integrated journey
tasks.outcome: Execute B06-T03 CPU gates and the reserved B06-T04/B06-T05 real-GPU journey on the frozen composition.
tasks.acceptance: Frozen CPU gates pass; GPU evidence proves task-bound CAS outputs, exactly-once settlement, compatible repetition and honest warm/nonreuse, cancellation per profile, changed-identity fencing, restart/interruption recovery, stale rejection, and owned-resource cleanup.

tasks.title: Capture final manifest and honest ledger state
tasks.outcome: Complete B06-T06 durable post-capture evidence, spend/attempt accounting, provider cleanup observation, and criterion/row disposition.
tasks.acceptance: Durable manifest binds outputs and source identities, budget accounting is reconciled, provider observation proves or leaves cleanup honestly unverified, and every row is accepted under scope or states blocked/failed/undetermined. Unsuccessful work is never EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Independent final integrated review
tasks.outcome: Conduct B06-T07 final holistic completion and strategic review as a separate configured final-reviewer leaf context.
tasks.acceptance: Independent final-reviewer leaf checks completion, evidence integrity, simplicity, and strategy against v3; it does not review its own implementation, waive failed evidence, reset budgets, or silently expand scope.

tasks.title: Record terminal disposition and archive
tasks.outcome: After B06-T07, record COMPLETED only for full acceptance or TERMINAL-HONEST with every failed/blocked/undetermined obligation, preserve evidence, verify provider-observed zero pods, and archive the run.
tasks.acceptance: Final status names 45/45 or an honest terminal, includes B06-T07 disposition and deferred receipts, proves zero pods by provider observation (or says unverified), and records push/archive only when separately authorized. No local process exit is treated as provider cleanup proof.
